mapper.insert: INSERT INTO survey_question (survey_id, standard_question_id, question_type, content, is_required, sort_no, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{surveyId}, #{standardQuestionId}, #{q.type}, #{q.text}, #{q.isRequired}, #{q.sort}, 0, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO survey_question_option (survey_question_id, standard_question_option_id, option_content, sort_no, create_time) VALUES (#{surveyQuestionId}, #{standardQuestionOptionId}, #{content}, #{sortNo}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, survey_id AS surveyId, standard_question_id AS standardQuestionId, question_type AS type, content AS text, is_required AS isRequired, sort_no AS sort FROM survey_question WHERE survey_id = #{surveyId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_no
SELECT id, option_content AS content, sort_no AS sort FROM survey_question_option WHERE survey_question_id = #{surveyQuestionId} ORDER BY sort_no
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM survey_question WHERE survey_id = #{surveyId} AND is_deleted = 0
